submissions.title: My submissions
submissions.subtitle: Build a canonical package from an installed app, add marketplace images, and submit it for human review.
submissions.signInRequired: Sign in with GitHub to create and manage submissions.
submissions.remoteUnsupported: Packaging and upload require a local workspace; submission history remains available.
submissions.newHint: Source and permissions come from the selected installed app; everything else is pre-filled — usually you only confirm the name, description, and marketplace images.
submissions.slugHint: 3–63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. It cannot change after first publication.
submissions.name: Public name
submissions.licenseHint: Declare an SPDX expression or a custom URL, not both.
submissions.screenshotHint: A 16:9 image is recommended for the marketplace; the first image becomes the listing cover. Keep the composition clear, the subject prominent, and key content near the center. Add 1–5 PNG, JPEG, or WebP files, up to 5 MiB each; 1920×1080 recommended.
submissions.captured: Added the current MiniApp view as a marketplace image.

submissions.missingFiles: Select a MiniApp and at least one marketplace image.
submissions.historyHint: Published releases remain available while a newer release is reviewed.

customize.title: Customize MiniApp
customize.riskTitle: Changes are previewed before they replace the app
customize.riskBody: The active app is unchanged until Apply. The current version is saved before replacement, and new permissions require a separate confirmation.
customize.requestPlaceholder: Example: make the interface lighter, or improve interaction feedback and layout details
customize.workspaceRequired: A workspace is required to launch the MiniApp editor.
customize.builtinUpdateBody: This app has local changes. Updating to the bundled version can overwrite those edits, so keep the local copy until you explicitly choose to update.
customize.dismissBuiltinUpdate: Do not remind for this version
customize.launchFailed: Preview copy is ready, but the editor failed to start: {{error}}
customize.applySaved: Applied. Previous version saved; use MiniApp versions to roll back.

permissionDialog.title: New permissions need confirmation
permissionDialog.body: This change adds or expands permissions. Review the changes before applying them to the active app.

unsupported.title: MiniApps are desktop-only
unsupported.body: Built-in MiniApps and the market run in the desktop BitFun app. Open the desktop app and use the MiniApp entry at the bottom-left of the navigation.
